_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Uploads multiple assets into draft storage.

description: Upload 1–200 CMS assets; key = path after /assets/, or sitePath for an exact URL path (e.g. /.well-known/security.txt, /ads.txt). Each item: exactly one of bodyBase64, bodyText (plain text for .css/.js/.mjs/.json/.svg/.txt/.xml only — not .html pages), or importFromUrl. Optional bodySha256 verifies submitted bytes before write; response sha256 is stored bytes (JS/CSS match; WebP rasters may differ). JPEG/PNG/static GIF are re-encoded to WebP (response key photo.webp; /assets/photo.jpg keeps serving it) — use the response key in CSS/JS; optimize:false stores the bytes as sent at your key; animated GIFs are always kept. Uploaded files are live in the editor and draft preview at once; the published site picks them up at the next publish.

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

bodySha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the submitted upload bytes (decoded bodyBase64 or raw PUT body). Mismatch returns body_sha256_mismatch before any write. Response/get_asset sha256 is the stored blob (WebP after IMAGES optimization for rasters; unchanged for JS/CSS/SVG).

key.description: Path after /assets/ on the site — e.g. photos/hero.webp or style.css. Do not prefix with assets/ or /. Uploaded files are live in the editor and draft preview at once; the published site picks them up at the next publish.

optimize.description: Default true: a JPEG, PNG or static GIF is re-encoded to WebP (key photo.jpg is stored as photo.webp, and /assets/photo.jpg still serves it). false stores the bytes exactly as sent, at the key given. Animated GIFs are always kept as sent.

sitePath.description: Store at this exact site path instead of /assets/{key} — e.g. /.well-known/security.txt, /ads.txt, /favicon.ico. Send key OR sitePath.

name: bulk_put_assets
